title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-11-09
ranking_explanation: Repositories are ranked by the stars-today figures observed on GitHub Trending at the snapshot time. Total stars, language, repository identity, default branch, latest default-branch commit, and push recency were corroborated with the GitHub REST API; GitHub Search API results also matched each listed repository.
global_caveat: GitHub Trending's stars-today and total-star counts are live, point-in-time values and can change. Star gains indicate attention, not project quality or its cause. No prior-window comparison was gathered, so no notable-shifts claim is made.

sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Daily snapshot at 2026-11-09 01:39 UTC; date range 2026-11-09 through 2026-11-09. Ranking basis: GitHub Trending daily star gains, corroborated with GitHub REST and Search APIs.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Today’s snapshot mixes an unusually large surge for Sherlock with fast-growing agent-facing tools: OpenMausBot, Astryx, and agent-browser. The broader signal is tooling around agents—interfaces, browser access, skills, and longer-lived context—alongside GPU infrastructure and physics simulation.

sections.title: sherlock-project/sherlock
sections.description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks
sections.content: A command-line tool that checks whether a username appears across 400+ social networks; its README documents multi-username checks and text, CSV, XLSX, and JSON output.
sections.why_notable: Leads the snapshot by a wide margin with +2,373 stars today.
sections.unique_caveat: The snapshot establishes the star gain, not its cause.

sections.title: milind-soni/OpenMausBot
sections.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use
sections.content: A desktop chat interface where distinct agent bots run with their own identity and tools; the README emphasizes local-first operation and agents installed on the user's machine.
sections.why_notable: Second-highest daily gain; the project combines a chat-style interface with local agent execution.
sections.unique_caveat: The README says it is an independent project and is not affiliated with xAI, Meta, OpenAI, or Manus.

sections.title: meta/astryx
sections.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
sections.content: A React 19+ design system with accessible components, themes, CLI tooling, and documentation designed for use by people and coding agents.
sections.why_notable: A strong daily gain for a design system, with tooling and documentation explicitly aimed at both developers and agents.
sections.unique_caveat: The README labels Astryx as currently in beta.

sections.title: vercel-labs/agent-browser
sections.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
sections.content: A native Rust CLI for agents to inspect pages as compact accessibility snapshots, act on element references, and verify outcomes step by step.
sections.why_notable: A highly ranked concrete tool-access pattern for agents: shell commands drive a persistent browser and return verifiable page state.
sections.unique_caveat: Element references describe a particular page snapshot and should be refreshed after navigation or DOM changes, according to its README.

sections.title: anthropics/skills
sections.content: Anthropic's public agent-skills repository; one of the snapshot's strongest daily gainers and the largest repository by total stars among these entries.
sections.why_notable: Strong daily gain and an established high-star repository central to reusable agent workflows.

sections.title: ranxianglei/billion-context
sections.description: A context-compression plugin for month-long single sessions and smaller context windows
sections.content: A context-compression plugin whose stated aim is to support very long agent sessions and reduce token use in smaller context windows.
sections.why_notable: Its +460 daily gain makes context management a visible supporting theme alongside agent execution tools.
sections.unique_caveat: The context-window and token-saving figures are project claims, not independently measured in this snapshot.

sections.title: dsx-ai-factory/nvke
sections.description: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE). A management plane for GPU Kubernetes on bare metal.
sections.content: A self-hosted management plane for creating and operating workload Kubernetes clusters on bare-metal NVIDIA GPU infrastructure.
sections.why_notable: The strongest infrastructure-oriented signal in the list, with +345 daily stars and a clear GPU cluster-management focus.
sections.unique_caveat: The README says the project is in preview, APIs and behavior can change, and it is not recommended for production workloads.

sections.title: google-deepmind/mujoco
sections.description: Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator.
sections.content: A general-purpose physics simulator for multi-joint dynamics with contact, representing robotics and simulation in this snapshot.
sections.why_notable: A domain counterpoint to the agent-tool cluster: physics simulation remains in today's trending set.

sections.title: anthropics/claude-quickstarts
sections.description: A collection of projects designed to help developers quickly get started with building deployable applications using the Claude API
sections.content: A set of example projects for developers building deployable applications with the Claude API.
sections.why_notable: Provides practical application examples, although its +32 gain is among the smallest in the set.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: The list points to agent interfaces and reusable workflows (OpenMausBot, anthropics/skills, claude-quickstarts); browser access and context management (agent-browser, billion-context); agent-aware frontend tooling (Astryx); GPU cluster infrastructure and physics simulation (NVKE, MuJoCo); and username OSINT (Sherlock). Python and TypeScript each appear in three repositories; Go, Rust, and C++ each appear once.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The dominant thread is the operating layer around agents: reusable skills, browser access, longer context, and interfaces that make agent work legible. Infrastructure and simulation remain present, while Sherlock's large one-day gain is an outsize standalone signal whose cause is not established by the data collected here.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary source: https://github.com/trending, observed at 2026-11-09 01:39 UTC. GitHub REST repository and Search APIs were queried for all nine repositories. Daily gain values are the stars-today figures displayed by GitHub Trending; current total stars and default-branch SHAs were separately checked through REST API. No prior-window evidence was gathered and no notable-shifts comparison is claimed.
